days.tag: 双图表总起+万能应急(第一段延伸)

sents.zh: 左侧的图展示了左图主题，而右侧的图列出了右图主题。
sents.en: The chart on the left shows 左图主题, while the chart on the right lists 右图主题.
sents.meta: 双图表第一段总起句:左右两图的内容分别套第①静态段或②动态段填数据。

sents.zh: 上方图表提供了年份1至年份2间关于题目相关词的信息。
sents.en: The chart above provides information about 题目相关词 from 年份1 to 年份2.
sents.meta: 万能应急句:图表看不懂/时间紧时总起就用它;细节补一句 with the proportions ranging from 最低值 to 最高值。

sents.en: Placed in the context of everyday life, the formation of 题目相关词 is propelled by the combined influence of multiple factors.
sents.zh: 放在日常生活的语境中思考，题目相关词的形成受到多重因素的共同推动。
sents.meta: 过渡句(书·经济类原句,已背零成本上岗);看法/流行/调查类图表把 the formation of 换 the popularity of。本段=过渡+原因1(现实升级)+原因2(意识加深),只换【题目相关词】【槽A】【槽B】三处空,三句约80词考场全写;字数富余再加批9句8。

sents.en: As real life continues to develop, people's expectations for 槽A(期望对象) no longer remain at the level of superficial satisfaction, which has undoubtedly laid a more solid foundation for 题目相关词.
sents.zh: 随着现实生活不断发展，人们对于槽A的要求已不再停留于表层满足，这无疑为题目相关词奠定了更坚实的现实基础。
sents.meta: 槽A与槽B同类别配对填:their living environment(环境生态)/their physical condition(体育健康)/their children's all-round growth(教育家庭)/a better material life(经济消费)/spiritual and cultural life(文化自信)/a healthier state of mind(心理健康)/daily convenience and efficiency(科技)。

sents.en: In addition, with public awareness of 槽B(意识对象) gradually deepening and related needs continuing to grow, 题目相关词 has been receiving increasing attention.
sents.zh: 除此之外，伴随着公众对槽B意识的逐渐加深与相关需求的不断增长，题目相关词也越来越受到重视。
sents.meta: 槽B配对填:environmental protection/health/quality education/traditional culture/rational consumption/mental health/digital literacy。谓语单复数:the popularity of X has been receiving / outdoor activities have been receiving。负面图表不用本段,字数留给第三段讲措施。

sents.en: In conclusion, the phenomenon reflected in the chart is bound to continue, and it will keep exerting a positive influence on 某方面.
sents.zh: 总之，图表所反映的现象必将持续下去，并将继续给某方面带来积极影响。
sents.meta: 趋势持续句,任何动态图通用;负面趋势把 positive 换 negative。

sents.en: Only through the joint efforts of 主体三方(如 the government, enterprises and the public) can we effectively promote 主题词的健康发展(按题换).
sents.zh: 只有通过(主体三方)的共同努力，我们才能有效促进主题词的健康发展。
sents.meta: Only倒装收尾;主体按题换:parents and schools / the whole society / the government and the public。

sents.en: It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to 题目相关词 by ourselves and our community.
sents.zh: 不难得出结论，我们个人和整个社会都必须对题目相关词给予足够的重视。
sents.meta: 静态总结句;想更具体可换:We should bear in mind that 题目相关词 is of great importance to 某方面。

sents.en: For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to 政府动作. For another, we should spare no pains to 个人动作, and new media platforms should appeal to the public to 呼吁动作.
sents.zh: 一方面，当局必须(政府动作)；另一方面，我们应该不遗余力地(个人动作)，新媒体平台也应呼吁公众(呼吁动作)。
sents.meta: 动作库:make strict laws / formulate policies / allocate more funds / improve public facilities ｜ raise public awareness of... / develop a habit of... / create more opportunities for sb. to... ｜ care for the elderly / live a healthy life / participate in outdoor activities。两点原因版:For one thing,...For another,...

sents.en: In this way, hopefully, we may embrace a brighter and more promising future.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，希望我们能拥抱一个更光明、更有希望的未来。
